title: IPC admin.trust.list result
description: One page of the profile's data-plane allowlist as `PeerTrustPolicy` holds it (2.1): the allowed peers, ascending by canonical string, at most 1024 a page, `persisted: false` on every row (a runtime overlay, ADR-0028); `next` is the last row's peer when more remain and absent on the last page; `local_peer`, this profile's own identity, is on the first page only and absent when the policy has none. Every peer not listed is denied: deny-by-default is the policy's shape, not a setting, so there is no default here and no per-peer decision, which is a local diagnostic (ADR-0032). A page of 1024 rows is about 84 KiB, under the 128 KiB body. architect-cto's ruling of 2026-10-04 (relay message 01a10820-b85d-74e6-bf40-e23b46c77a82).

allowed.description: Unique by peer and strictly ascending; JSON Schema cannot state the order, the Rust mirror refuses a page that breaks it.
